Specification row: Field, Content
Specification row: `answer`, Structured markdown (grounded in live Google Search results)
Specification row: `answered`, `true` if Gemini returned a non-empty answer
Specification row: `citations`, `["src_001", "src_002", ...]` - source labels
Specification row: `rich_citations`, `[{chunk_id, document, url, pages, preview}]`
Specification row: `routing`, `"current_affairs_grounding"`
Specification row: `search_queries`, The Google Search queries Gemini executed
Specification row: `log_info`, Human-readable description with queries used
> **Google Search Grounding requires a paid/billing-enabled Gemini API key.
Specification row: Aspect, Old (Web Scraping), New (Gemini Grounding)
Specification row: **Search Providers**, DDG + SearXNG + Bing, Google Search (native)
Specification row: **Scraping**, BeautifulSoup + requests, None (Gemini handles it)
Specification row: **Reranking**, MiniLM Cross-Encoder, None needed
Specification row: **Latency**, ~8-12 seconds, ~2-4 seconds
Specification row: **Result Quality**, Depends on trusted sites whitelist, Google Search (highest quality)
Specification row: **Citation Type**, `[chk_001]` chunk IDs, `[src_001]` web source URLs
Specification row: **Billing**, Free (no API key for search), Paid Gemini API key required
Specification row: **Freshness**, Subject to scraping failures, Real-time via Google
